purpose: 45k policy EE tracking stress-test with dynamic wide-range goals for floor pickup
sampling_frame: yaw/gravity-aligned spherical coordinates relative to the AS2 PiPER arm base
sampler: Original VBC independent spherical sampling, dynamic interpolation and ten retries. Evaluation-only local underground cutoff is -0.40m (from -0.30m) so the sampled TCP can approach the world floor; the original box collision check remains active.
command: stand (vx=0, yaw=0); no scripted leg crouch or scripted gait
checkpoint_training_range: The checkpoint was trained with restricted VBC ranges radius [0.46,0.49]m, pitch [0.30,0.45]rad, yaw [-0.10,0.10]rad and small orientation deltas. This evaluation expands the range only; it does not retrain the policy.
